summary: From Discuss I used the Home Menu > Contacts, clicked New, and created a Company-type contact: Name "fwod91-n1 Bench Customer", City "Benchville" (no other required fields were mandated, and Odoo accepted the record without them). I saved with the form's save button and then reloaded the record URL to verify persistence: the page title, breadcrumb heading and the Name field all show "fwod91-n1 Bench Customer" and the City field shows "Benchville" on the saved record at id=44.

text: In Odoo, go to the Sales app and create a new quotation (Sales > Orders > Quotations > New). Set the Customer to 'fwod91-n1 Bench Customer' — this is an autocomplete dropdown, so type the name and actually select the matching option from the dropdown list so it is properly chosen. Add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue (again an autocomplete dropdown — select an actual option from the dropdown), with quantity 3. Do not add any other lines. Save the quotation. Report: the product name you chose, the unit price the app filled in for that line, and the Untaxed Amount the quotation computes (as shown on the page). Do not wait for network idle; wait on concrete page state.

text: In Odoo, open the existing quotation S00021 (customer 'fwod91-n1 Bench Customer', one line: [FURN_6666] Acoustic Bloc Screens qty 3). Keep the existing first line unchanged. Save the quotation. summary: Order S00021 was cancelled and the cancellation is verified: after reloading the record I read the status bar and its current radio is "Cancelled" (checked, disabled), the Confirm and Cancel buttons are gone, and the only remaining workflow action is "Set to Quotation". To get there I clicked Cancel, which opened the "Cancel Sales Order" wizard showing the alert "Are you sure you want to cancel this order?" with options "Send and cancel" (action_send_mail_and_cancel, which would also email the customer) and "Cancel" (action_cancel); I clicked "Cancel". An unrelated "Edit: fwod91-n1 Bench Customer" contact dialog had stacked on top of the wizard and blocked the first click, so I closed it with Discard (no edits made) and the wizard click then landed, immediately flipping the status to Cancelled. (remaining_statusbar_action: Confirm/Cancel buttons gone)

values.dialog_used: Cancel Sales Order wizard; clicked button name=action_cancel ("Cancel") rather than action_send_mail_and_cancel ("Send and cancel", which emails the customer)
